title: excoecaria indica
intro: Excoecaria indica, commonly known as the Yellow Oleander, is a flowering plant native to the tropical regions of Asia and Australia. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and treat various skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Excoecaria indica are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which are mediated by its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of the plant, including flavoglaucine and 3,4-dimethoxy-phenylacetic acid, contribute to its therapeutic effects and potential health benefits.
